title: Mental causation is real, upward and downward

statements.text: Because brain cells are themselves centers of experience and a moment of human experience is an actuality of its own, mental causation is not epiphenomenal. There is upward causation from body to mind, self-determination by the mind, and downward causation from mind to body, with no dualistic interaction.

sources.quote: Mental causation, accordingly, is not regarded as epiphenomenal.
Besides the upward causation from the body to the mind, there is self-determination by the mind and, on the basis of this, downward causation from the mind to the body.
